ideas.idea: Add address and directions text to the Visit page, since its meta description promises directions
ideas.why: The description says 'Opening times and directions' but the page body has only opening months, so this is a real, file-backed content gap.

ideas.idea: Add LocalBusiness JSON-LD for hours and location on the Visit page
ideas.why: It is accurate, but the brief says having no JSON-LD is not a required fix, and the payoff is modest.

ideas.idea: List all forty-plus varieties and create a page per variety, such as /varieties/ashmeads-kernel
ideas.why: The varieties page names only two of 'over forty' varieties, so per-variety pages would give people and machines real content to find.

ideas.idea: Add in-text links from the home page to Varieties and Visit
ideas.why: The home page does only have the nav links, but the nav already links to both pages, so extra in-text links change little.

ideas.idea: Add lastmod dates to sitemap.xml entries
ideas.why: This is accurate because no lastmod exists, but it is standard sitemap advice with small effect on a three-URL site.
